about: violet moon-blade sword swings (sideways, down, spin) with a white edge, and a gold impact spark

animations.name: slash
animations.about: a sideways swing: a white-edged violet crescent with a dithered afterimage sweeps over the top from left to right (plays once, ends empty)

animations.name: slash-down
animations.about: a downward chop on the right: the crescent sweeps from top to bottom (plays once, ends empty)

animations.name: slash-spin
animations.about: a spin attack: the crescent runs once round a flat ellipse (plays once, ends empty)

animations.name: hit
animations.about: an impact spark: a three-pointed gold-white flash with a hot burst, then a scatter of sparks (plays once, ends empty)
